item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
What's New

  • Each display's detail page has a Display section: power, resolution, refresh rate, rotation and HDR.
  • Turn a display off without unplugging it (Apple Silicon). It shows as a gray display on the wallpaper shelf; click it to turn the display back on.
  • Displays you turned off come back on when you quit Loomscreen, or the next time it starts.
  • A resolution, refresh rate or rotation change goes back after 15 seconds unless you keep it.
  • The home page background ripples faintly under the pointer and where you click empty space. Turn it off in Settings › Appearance.
